THE 3 LOST CELLS — css-tables/height-distribution/percentage-sizing-of-table-cell-children-
003/-004/-006 Android (P 0.9954 → f 0.9966, colorFailed: the abspos z-index:-1 red 100x100
square is visible because the green `overflow-y:auto; height:100%; min-height:100px` child
of a `height:100%` table cell renders 0-tall) — were BISECTED ON DEVICE, not reasoned about
(tools/titan/results/wave50-gate/lost-cells-bisection.json): retro R2's percent-clamp lane
disabled → still red; every wave-50 Compose change reverted → still red; the wave-49 sizing/
layout/table/scroll files → still red; the COMPLETE wave-49 Compose runtime (226 files) →
still red. The per-test IR is byte-identical to wave49-final and the harness app differs by
comments only. So neither the retro's nor wave 50's Compose code is the cause; the
remaining suspects are the build toolchain / dependency resolution, the emulator system
image or provisioning flags, or a capture-timing dependency the quiet host exposes. Recorded
as a loss of 3 cells (one test family) and queued at the top of BACKLOG for wave 51 with the
four A/B run recipes; siblings -005 and -007 are byte-unchanged.

two: visual-test exit 5 — 17 stale ledger lines DELETED (9 ios-borders-radius: retro R4's
clip fix confirmed; 6 android-harness-placeholder-floor: wave-50 B11; 2 android-effects-blur:

nested-transforms exit 5 — its 3 Android waivers DELETED (retro R1's pivot fix confirmed);
radius-overflow-transform 0 (B8's iOS clip-inside-transform passes the oracle; waiver deleted
pre-gate); composition-test, transform-abspos-pivot, opacity-blend 0; and two iOS-only
exit-4s — filter-sepia-amounts 006_Sepia_Translucent (iOS-Android/iOS-web 0.9931, Δpx 17 %,
ΔE95 11.5) and blend-isolation 003_wrapper (0.9492). RESOLVED: 003_wrapper was a real iOS
defect, FIXED — SwiftUI's .blendMode propagates to every leaf so a mix-blend-mode box blended its
own glyphs against its own background; BlendModeApplier.swift now chains .compositingGroup()
first (compositing-1 §3.1/§5.1), pinned by BlendGroupCompositingTests on a Catalyst raster proven
byte-identical to the simulator captures. Sepia_Translucent was NOT a render change: the live
iOS raster is (95,117,129), the exact src-over composite the 2026-08-28 ledger text recorded,
against web/Android's (90,92,95); the retro (R13) had deleted its two ledger lines after
re-scoring a committed iOS PNG that never matched the live render. Both lines are RESTORED with
the live numbers (owner ios-effects-filter-composite) and iOS__006 is re-baselined to the render
the code declares; the composite fix stays open in BACKLOG 6(x²). BASELINES REFRESHED after measuring every changed PNG
against its committed version and the web render and inspecting the crops: 35 PNGs — 30 of
33 native ones moved TOWARD web (iOS label spill 019/020/022/101/107 + 13 radius shifts,
Android 091/094/105 → 390x62, 032 blur, 016/017/018 borders, 097); the three that moved away
are Android 098_Neumorphic_Light (a small hard corner where R6's border-box knockout meets a
rounded box — queued), iOS 098 (R4's clip now REVEALS the already-ledgered iOS shadow-σ
divergence the old clip hid) and iOS 093/094 noise. 046_Perspective_Rotate moved on ALL
THREE from a trapezoid to an axis-aligned rectangle: `perspective` is the element's OWN
property, which css-transforms-2 §6 applies to its children, so the rectangle is correct and
the old three-way agreement was a degenerate pass (retro R1).

PROVENANCE OF THIS RUN VS THE SHIPPED TREE (stated plainly). The corpus was captured 21:14-22:34 UTC
on the tree as it stood after the fix lanes and the sweep. Two changes landed AFTER the run, from the
fixture net's own findings: (1) the iOS blend-isolation fix (BlendModeApplier.swift chains
.compositingGroup() before .blendMode — a mix-blend-mode element's glyphs no longer blend against its
own background); its ONLY corpus carriers are two iOS cells whose IR declares a non-normal blend and
both sit at P 1.0000 in this run (css-masking/clip-path-blending-offset, filter-effects/
backdrop-filter-with-mix-blend-mode-same-element) — re-measure them at the wave-51 gate; every other
corpus cell is unaffected by construction. (2) ledger/baseline/waiver edits (17 stale ledger lines and
3 stale nested-transforms waivers deleted, the two Sepia_Translucent ledger lines RESTORED with live
numbers, 35 visual-test + 7 filter-sepia baselines refreshed) — these change the fixture net's
